# v1 memory fixture provenance

The three Markdown files in this directory are byte-for-byte copies of the
archived v1 sample workspace at:

`../cascade-v1/examples/sample-workspace/.cascade/memory/`

They were harvested on 2026-09-12. `feedback-redacted.md` was harvested from
an active v1 `~/.cascade/memory/` frontmatter record on the same date. Its
name, description, and body were replaced with `REDACTED`; the observed field
set, order, fences, and `feedback` type were retained.

These are inputs to the v2 importer, never outputs from it. The archive is
reference-only and no v1 implementation source was copied.
